name: Maryland Community Compass
description:
Maryland Community Compass is the State of Maryland's free neighborhood development platform that centralizes data insights, funding resources, and support to foster thriving businesses and communities statewide, built by the Maryland State Innovation Team in partnership with Anthropic. Since December 2025 it has served over 15,000 active users and helped guide nearly $14 million in state funding to high-need areas.

Its MCP server exposes 20 read-only tools that let Claude answer questions about any Maryland address, parcel, or geography. No authentication is required, though requests must come from a US-based network.

Find Funding: 2,600+ federal, state, and philanthropic programs aggregated from 100+ sources, spanning grants, loans, tax credits, and technical assistance. One of the most comprehensive databases of public and private funding in Maryland. Full-text search, filters, and profile-based recommendations that help assemble a capital stack for any project.

Site Feasibility: parcel-level evaluation across hundreds of federal, state, and local datasets. Property records, Maryland place-based program overlays (Opportunity Zone, Enterprise Zone, Sustainable Community, and more), environmental cleanup sites, historic register listings, conservation easements, green infrastructure, and Baltimore City Vacant Building Notices. Includes full zoning ordinance text for all 23 Maryland counties and 96 municipalities with independent planning authority.

Community Plans: nearly 200 published comprehensive, small-area, and neighborhood plans. Search inside any plan (for example, "what does the Fell's Point plan say about parking?") with citation-ready PDF URLs.

Neighborhood Insights: 58 census-tract-level metrics (poverty, tenure, cost burden, rental vacancy, permits, and more) with state and county medians for comparison.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Maryland Community Compass to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Maryland Community Compass to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://compass.maryland.gov/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Maryland Community Compass MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Maryland Community Compass scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Maryland Community Compass MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maryland Community Compass lists 20 MCP tools, including geocode_address, get_program_details, get_statistics, list_community_plans, list_filter_options, list_zoning_jurisdictions, list_zoning_sections, lookup_environmental, lookup_historic, lookup_natural_resources, lookup_neighborhood_indicators, and lookup_parcel.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Maryland Community Compass?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Maryland Community Compass in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Maryland Community Compass MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maryland Community Compass does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Why is Maryland Community Compass failing MCP readiness checks?
